_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing short lines for shopping

items.en: Do you have a small one?
items.gloss_en: Do you have a smaller one?

segments.text: Shopping in English? Here are four easy lines. Repeat after me.
Do you have a small one?

native.caption: 出国购物不敢开口？这 4 句一定要收藏，比如“How much for this one?”和“Can I try it on?”。先听 Ama 老师示范，再在停顿时跟读。更多口语练习，尽在 Lexkite 应用。

en.hook: How do you shop in English?
en.caption: Afraid to speak when shopping abroad? Save these 4 lines, such as “How much for this one?” and “Can I try it on?” First listen to teacher Ama, then repeat in the pause. More speaking practice is in the Lexkite app.
